meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: Claude 会说「HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!」,作为 Lead 组建 5 个互相攻击的对抗成员交叉批判,只留站得住脚的结论,再强制交给 plan agent 写成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说「hyperplan」「hpp」「/hyperplan」等触发词,或计划需要最大严谨度、要暴露薄弱假设与过度设计时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划一次数据库迁移
say.note: 先组建对抗团队批判,再交给 plan agent 出计划

say.text: hyperplan:评估要不要把单体拆成微服务
say.note: 5 个成员从不同角度互相攻击结论

say.text: hpp 帮我把这个重构方案做一轮敌对审查
say.note: 只保留经得住攻击的结论再形式化

howto.what_en: Claude announces "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", leads 5 mutually hostile agents through cross-critique, keeps only defensible insights, then mandatorily hands the bundle to the `plan` agent for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "hyperplan", "hpp", "/hyperplan" and similar phrases, or when planning needs maximum rigor and must surface weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan a database migration.
say_en.note: 5 hostile agents critique, then the plan agent formalizes.

say_en.text: hyperplan: should we split this monolith into services?
say_en.note: Members attack the proposal from differing angles.

say_en.text: hpp — adversarially review this refactor plan.
say_en.note: Only defensible insights survive into the plan.
